info.title: Agent service
info.description: The agent service provides AI agents that assist users with tasks such as building forms. Use the socket.io interface for streaming, multi-turn conversations.

get.description: Gets one topic of the documented Access Service guidance used by the Access Service agent, such as client setup, token expiry, or identity providers. Static: no AI is involved and no tenant data is read, so the tenant admin app uses it to answer predefined questions about documented topics without a model call. Available to any authenticated user.

404.description: No guide topic with the ID.

example.errorMessage: access guide topic with ID 'no-such-topic' could not be found.

get.description: Gets the Access Service environment and realm the current user may inspect (read-only). Available to any authenticated user; it deliberately does not require the agent-user role, so that it can tell users which role they are missing. Determined from the verified user token only; no AI is involved and no tenant data is read. Returns status "unavailable" with a reason and message, rather than an error, when the user cannot inspect (for example, without the urn:ads:platform:agent-service:agent-user role).

available.summary: User can inspect their tenant realm

value.message: You can inspect the 3c1f9a52-6b7d-4e8a-9f0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b realm in Production (read-only).

missingRole.summary: User does not have the agent-user role

value.message: You do not have the role needed to inspect the Access Service. Ask your tenant administrator to assign it.

get.description: Gets the ID and name of every agent available in the tenant: the platform (core) agents and the agents the tenant has configured. Available to any authenticated user; no role is required, and agents restricted by userRoles are listed too. A platform agent replaces a tenant agent with the same ID.

Gets the ID and name of an agent. Available to any authenticated user; no role is required, even for agents restricted by userRoles. An agent ID that is not configured for the tenant or the platform responds 404.

post.description: Sends one or more user messages to an agent and responds with its complete reply. Available to any authenticated user when the agent has no userRoles; otherwise the user needs one of the agent's userRoles in the tenant, so core users can only use agents without userRoles. The agent-user role is not checked on this operation. Each request starts a new thread, so the agent has no context from earlier requests; use the socket.io interface for multi-turn conversations and streaming.

value.content: Which fields should a business licence renewal form include?
My business is a food truck in Edmonton.
Which permits do I need to renew?

delete.description: Deletes one of the signed-in user's own conversation threads, with its stored messages, observations and workspace, so a new chat starts without its context. Available to any authenticated user when the agent has no userRoles; otherwise the user needs one of the agent's userRoles in the tenant. Returns deleted false when the user has no thread with this ID in the tenant, including one that belongs to another user or tenant, so repeating the request is harmless.

notFound.summary: User has no thread with the ID

AgentId.name: agentId
AgentId.description: ID of the agent, as configured in the agent-service configuration.

AgentTenantId.name: tenantId
AgentTenantId.description: ID of the tenant to act on. Only used for core (platform) users; tenant users always act on the tenant of their token and this parameter is ignored. Without it, core users see only the platform (core) agents. Must be the full URN of an existing tenant.

ThreadId.name: threadId
ThreadId.description: ID of the conversation thread, as sent as threadId on the socket.io message event.

AgentBadRequest.description: Request is invalid, for example the tenantId query parameter is not a valid ADSP ID, or the request body is not valid JSON.
